Afzelia_quanzensis.note: Listing in force from 2023-02-23. African populations only. Brief names A. africana, A. bipindensis, A. pachyloba, A. quanzensis and look-alikes A. bella, A. parviflora, A. peturei. CoP20 rejected Congo/Gabon proposal to remove A. bipindensis from App II.

Khaya_anthotheca.note: In force from 2023-02-23. Five recognised species per brief; nomenclature unresolved (Decision 19.284).

Pericopsis_elata.note: Annotation amended at CoP18. Cote d'Ivoire trade suspension recommendation since 2012.

Pterocarpus_angolensis.note: In force from 2023-02-23. 12 African species incl. P. angolensis, P. soyauxii, P. tessmannii; P. erinaceus (listed 2016) and P. tinctorius (listed 2019) earlier. P. santalinus (Asia) is separate (App II, #7). CoP20 rejected Congo/Gabon proposal to remove P. soyauxii.
